# About the Author {.unnumbered .about-author}

**Ravi Kalia** holds a PhD in statistical machine learning from the University of Oxford and
has spent twenty years working with data, in several industries and on many continents.

This book is the written edition of Ravi's hands-on Quarto workshop. The workshop's slides are
at <https://project-delphi.github.io/quarto-workshop/>, and its worked examples and catch-up
checkpoints at <https://github.com/project-delphi/quarto-workshop>.
